## Selected highlights

- PhD Candidate in Geography, University of Florida.
- Graduate Certificate in Digital Geography and GIS.
- Research interests: collaborative governance of conservation, CBNRM, environmental justice, social-ecological systems, political ecology, economic geography, GIS, spatial statistics, and Southern Africa.
- Instructor of record for Economic Geography, Social Geography, and Population Geography.
- Research Fellow with the Science for Nature and People Partnership CBNRM Governance & Economics Working Group.
- Research Fellow with the Global Environment Facility Fonseca Leadership Program / Life Through Wildlife Fonseca Fellowships.
- Co-organizer and co-facilitator of CBNRM governance, wildlife economics, and Governance Dashboard workshops in Namibia and South Africa.
